candidate.answerReason: If three fourths equal 12, one fourth equals 4 and the whole equals 16.

methods.label: Recover the whole from equal fourths
methods.explanation: \(\frac{3}{4}\) of a number is 12. These are three equal fourths, so one fourth is \(12 \div 3 = 4\), and four fourths total \(4 \times 4 = 16\). The number is \(12 \div \frac{3}{4} = 16\).
methods.levelReason: Recovering a whole through equal fractional parts is within Grade 6 and requires only elementary multiplication and division.
